applied.legacy_bright_ROI_count_scope: Simulation deficits only; excludes dark measured pixels. Not a measure of reproduction of real EPI signal losses.

signal_loss_evaluation: MSE already penalizes both signal excess and deficit. Additional bidirectional diagnostics expose real low-signal regions missed by the simulation. They do not infer the cause of signal loss or change the simulated zero-B0 target.

selection.criterion: validation NRMSE, nested 1/2/3 parameters; starts selected by fit cost only

split.kind: internal guarded spatial blocks of one measured RSS image

interpretation: Effective residual parameters inferred from magnitude; not independently measured hardware constants.
readout_shift_interpretation: Assumed rigid GRE object/B0 registration shift; ACDC spatial maps must be resampled. Zero-current RSS cannot distinguish this from an instrumental phase-ramp/origin error or establish imaging-to-ACDC registration.
target_policy: Rebuild native MRzero: zero-B0 target removes fitted frequency offset; translated object and residual ADC phase remain.
limitations: Pixels share a reconstructed acquisition and spatial correlations; guard bands do not create independent measurements.
This acquisition previously informed model development; internal test is a diagnostic, not external validation.
Frequency and phase-encode displacement are almost degenerate; phase-encode displacement is fixed.
Odd/even parameter is only a constant residual AFTER existing navigator correction, not a second navigator correction.

B0_regularization.method: Fixed known in-plane B0 gradients and refined center B0 from complex multi-echo fit; no second smoothing.

complex_multi_echo_report.gpu_name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
complex_multi_echo_report.solver: bounded batched variable-projection Levenberg-Marquardt; analytic reduced normal equations
complex_multi_echo_report.quality_policy: Residual diagnostic only; poor agreement never resets fitted decay or dispersion.
complex_multi_echo_report.amplitude_policy: Positive receive-weighted envelope at reference TE excluding all known and unresolved dephasing factors.
complex_multi_echo_report.frequency_policy: exp(-2*pi*i*B0*(TE-reference_TE)); initial field fixes the frequency alias neighborhood.
complex_multi_echo_report.unresolved_dispersion_policy: Unlocalized frequency distribution; no inferred z direction, spatial gradient sign, or ACDC-recoverable fraction. Retain in zero-macroscopic-B0 target.
complex_multi_echo_report.uncertainty_policy: No physical uncertainty or identifiability claim follows from the residual check or internal echo holdout.
limitations: A small family of symmetric frequency distributions is an effective model, not an inferred frequency spectrum.
Echo holdout checks temporal prediction within one acquisition; it is not independent scanner validation.
Frequencies outside the fixed alias neighborhood and between-echo frequency structure are not identified.
Receiver sensitivities are assumed constant through the echo train and unresolved distribution.
Known in-plane dephasing uses a local linear-field, uniform-voxel approximation at each echo TE.

reference_amplitude_prior.amplitude_policy: Receive-weighted reference-TE envelope; GRE is not a PD or T1 map.
reference_amplitude_prior.contrast_policy: Positive smooth effective GRE-to-multi-echo acquisition contrast fitted from training complex-echo amplitudes only, plus one global intensity gain; no PD/T1/B1 inference.
reference_amplitude_prior.geometry_policy: Registered physical coordinates; no extrapolation, registration, support expansion, or invented fine-resolution detail.
reference_amplitude_prior.resolution_limitation: GRE is sampled onto the native multi-echo grid without an inverse point-spread model. Only exponential TE contrast is transferred; no native-voxel sinc/coherence correction is asserted for a differently sized GRE voxel. Reserved echoes gate this effective-voxel prior.
reference_amplitude_prior.temporal_policy: Keep complex-echo B0, residual decay and unresolved dispersion unchanged.
reference_amplitude_prior.validation_policy: Train temporal parameters, complex receiver amplitudes and reference gain without reserved echoes; select prior with reserved complex noise-weighted SSE; final amplitude reapplied to all-echo fit.
reference_amplitude_prior.validation_limitation: Internal selection in the same acquisition; not independent EPI validation or a physical uncertainty bound.
reference_amplitude_prior.reference_TE_transfer: Exponential envelope only; known and unresolved coherence are never divided out of GRE in joint mode.
reference_amplitude_prior.common_domain_policy: Measured GRE coverage, positive native training amplitude and finite stable exponential TE transfer; no cross-resolution sinc-null mask is asserted.
reference_amplitude_prior.joint_reference_role: Registered anatomy and receive-weighted amplitude prior, calibrated jointly with native complex-echo amplitudes; independent of the measured GRE optimization target.
reference_amplitude_prior.validation_initial_B0_source: stored early-echo seed used by the principal complex fit
reference_amplitude_prior.contrast_field_policy: Positive normalized masked-Gaussian log-ratio; unit geometric mean on common training coverage; global gain estimated separately.
reference_amplitude_prior.decision: Reference did not pass the reserved-echo improvement gate; retained native amplitude.

preparation.baseline_calibration_interpretation: Readout displacement is assumed to be a rigid GRE object/B0 registration shift; zero-current magnitude cannot distinguish a phase-ramp origin error or validate imaging-to-ACDC registration.
preparation.baseline_calibration_phase_convention: phase_offset_rad += -0.5 * polarity * odd_even_phase_rad; residual after navigator correction; retained in zero-B0 target
preparation.baseline_calibration_frequency_conventio: constant Hz offset added after local B0/gradient fit; removed with B0 in zero-B0 target

calibration_pose.registration_note: Placement Bay5 confirmé précédemment ; orientation d'imagerie réglée ci-dessus.
calibration_pose.registration_validation: The supplied transform is used as declared; interpolation coverage and synthetic tests do not establish physical registration.
calibration_pose.through_plane_B0: Measured 2D B0 repeated through thickness; no measured normal gradient.

preparation.missing_calibration_policy: Exclude complete parent; never fill unknown ACDC response or renormalize retained amplitude.
preparation.through_plane_B0: Unmeasured normal B0 derivative assumed zero; no gradient inferred from echo width.
preparation.through_plane_sampling: one center; exact analytic full-thickness box factor

comparison_policy.secondary_domain: fixed envelope from uncalibrated zero-B0 target; diagnostic only
comparison_policy.point_comparison_gain: same before-calibration gain as the uncalibrated finite-voxel model
